# Layout

Layout holds the controls that arrange children you write yourself: panels for several children, containers for one, scrolling, and panes. A control that builds its children from data is under [Collections](../controls/index.md#collections).

## Panels

| Page | |
| --- | --- |
| [Canvas](canvas.md) | Children placed at absolute left/top offsets (DIPs) from its top-left corner, drawn in z-index order. |
| [Fill](fill.md) | A child of a stack that is given the room the other children leave. |
| [Grid](grid.md) | A two-dimensional layout panel: children placed in cells of row and column tracks, each track Auto, a fraction of the remaining space, or fixed DIPs. |
| [LayoutPanel](layout-panel.md) | A panel whose measure and arrange are delegated to an attachable Layout. |
| [Panel](panel.md) | The shared base of the layout panels that own a list of children: `Canvas`, `WrapPanel`, `TilePanel`, `RelativePanel` and `LayoutPanel`. |
| [RelativePanel](relative-panel.md) | Lays out children relative to each other and to the panel's edges. |
| [Spacer](spacer.md) | A gap in a stack that takes the room the other children leave. |
| [Stack](stack.md) | Lays its children out in a single column or row, `spacing` apart. |
| [TilePanel](tile-panel.md) | A grid of equal cells that children fill in order, each spanning as many rows and columns of cells as it asks for, wrapping to a new line when one is full. |
| [WrapPanel](wrap-panel.md) | A panel that places its children one after another along a line and starts a new line when the next child would cross the far edge. |

## Containers

| Page | |
| --- | --- |
| [Border](border.md) | One child inside a background, a border and padding. |
| [DensityScope](density-scope.md) | A wrapper that measures and draws its one child at compact or standard control density, which applies the compact sizing to one subtree. |
| [Expander](expander.md) | A header row that shows or hides one piece of content below or above it. |
| [GroupBox](group-box.md) | A header over a group of related controls, with the group framed. |
| [ScaleToFit](scale-to-fit.md) | One child, laid out at its natural size and drawn scaled to the room the ScaleToFit is given. |
| [Shortcuts](shortcuts.md) | Keyboard shortcuts for one area of a window. |
| [Toolbar](toolbar.md) | A horizontal strip of commands, usually Buttons, with optional separators between groups. |

## Scrolling and Gestures

| Page | |
| --- | --- |
| [AnnotatedScrollBar](annotated-scroll-bar.md) | A vertical scroll bar with a rail you click or drag to jump, up and down step buttons, and offset annotations that stay visible and hide when they collide. |
| [Parallax](parallax.md) | Moves its single child at a different rate than another element scrolls, typically a background image behind a list or scroll view. |
| [PullToRefresh](pull-to-refresh.md) | A container that refreshes its content when it is pulled past its start, with a progress indicator. |
| [Scroll](scroll.md) | A viewport that scrolls and zooms one child, with overlay scroll bars. |
| [Swipe](swipe.md) | Reveals a strip of action items beside its content when the content is dragged sideways: the "swipe a list row to reveal Delete/Archive" pattern. |

## Panes and Splitters

| Page | |
| --- | --- |
| [ResizeGripper](resize-gripper.md) | A fixed-size corner drag handle that reports two-axis deltas while dragged. |
| [SidePane](side-pane.md) | A content area with a pane beside it that opens, closes and collapses to a compact strip. |
| [Splitter](splitter.md) | A draggable divider that resizes along one axis, between two Grid tracks or two panes. |
| [TwoPane](two-pane.md) | Two content panes that sit side by side when there is width, stacked when there is height, and collapse to one pane when there is neither. |
